hook: Five people were stuck in Houston floodwater.
narration: She rode this basket up out of a flooded Houston neighborhood.
Hurricane Harvey had put whole streets underwater, and people were wading through it.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew from Air Station Houston lowered the basket on a cable.
The basket is a cage, so someone with no training can just sit inside [short pause] and hold on.
outcome: The crew pulled all five people out of the floodwater.
title: Basket rescue over flooded Houston
description:
A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Air Station Houston rescued five people from floodwaters in a southeastern Houston neighborhood during Hurricane Harvey, Aug. 27, 2017.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Corinne Zilnicki, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Coast_Guard_rescues_5_stranded_in_Houston_floodwaters_(546164).webm
